items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Eckstine came on that band... Eckstine came in as a singer... Eckstine used to sing with us off and on

ctx.x: And then you went on to Earl Hines together?

Yeah. Well, what actually happened was we had such good arrangements in that band and some real good players because eventually Eckstine came on that band, and Tyree Glenn came on that band eventually.
